scope: Move the behavioral role/output/research prompt contract into one server module backed by an owner-visible, editable Markdown document. Persist a validated private active revision and snapshot it at consultation acceptance. No GoDaddy application, database, migration, reset, deletion, deployment or external upload was contacted.

checks.name: runtime contract parser and renderer
checks.observed: The checked-in Markdown baseline parses into all required sections; a missing required placeholder is rejected; a valid saved edit is rendered into model assignments with placeholders resolved.
checks.limit: This deterministic check does not establish useful output from every third-party model.

checks.name: authenticated Settings API and immutable run snapshot
checks.observed: The owner can read the baseline, save a valid revision, receive a validation error for invalid Markdown, and the accepted consultation run retains the saved Markdown and revision.
checks.limit: The isolated HTTP fixture uses the local memory store and an unavailable provider; hosted MySQL durability and live provider execution remain release checks.

checks.name: regression suite
checks.observed: Static artifact checks passed and 45 Node tests passed.
checks.limit: The suite does not replace prepared release QA/DoD evidence or actual browser/provider/host checks.

checks.name: local browser Settings review
checks.evidence: Isolated local app at http://127.0.0.1:4323/ in the Codex in-app browser
checks.observed: After local sign-in and consent, Settings displayed the complete Markdown document and approved baseline revision. Replacing one Direct Head Answer sentence and clicking Save runtime instructions produced a distinct saved revision and explicit future-consultations confirmation.
checks.limit: This verifies the local browser interaction only; it does not prove real-provider output, Safari/Chrome compatibility, hosted MySQL durability or production deployment.
